name: @martinthommesen/oc-auth
description: oc-auth: an OpenCode v2 plugin for Claude Code subscription credentials.
author: Martin Lammetun Thommesen <267603464+martinthommesen@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.pretest: node -e "const n=require('node:fs').globSync('src/**/*.test.ts').length; if (n < 9) { console.error('expected at least 9 test files, found '+n); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.verify:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (!m.default?.id) { throw new Error('dist/index.js does not export a plugin') } }); if (!require('node:fs').existsSync('./dist/tui.js')) { throw new Error('dist/tui.js is missing') }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm -w run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:effect && pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run verify:dist && pnpm pack --dry-run
